items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Solid Starting Kicker Option vs Cardinals In Week 8
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey righted the ship of his rough season in Week 7 by making all three of his field goal attempts and not missing an extra point, finishing with 14 fantasy points. He's struggled with accuracy this season, making just 80 percent of his field goal attempts. But the Cowboys should have an easy time running up the score against the hapless Arizona Cardinals defense in Week 8. Interestingly, kickers don't fare particularly well against them in fantasy football, though that could be due to them allowing 3.5 touchdowns per contest this year. Arizona is bottom-8 at stopping opposing teams in the red zone. Aubrey may kick more extra points than field goals, but…

items.h: Makes all six kicks in MNF victory
items.s: Aubrey made all three of his field-goal attempts and all three PAT tries in Monday's 38-21 win over the Eagles. Aubrey benefited from a bounce-back performance out of Dallas' offense, as he had been limited to one field-goal attempt and two PATs over the previous two games combined. Monday marked the third time Aubrey made three field goals in a game this season, as he connected from 55, 27 and 24 yards. Aubrey's likely to remain busy in Week 8 against the Cardinals, who are giving up a league-high 29.7 points per game.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey scores 12 points in win Monday
items.s: Brandon Aubrey went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles. Aubrey had a perfect showing on Monday night, making all six of his kicks in a win over the Eagles. He is one of the NFL's best kickers and should continue to produce like it moving forward.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Fringe Starting Option In Fantasy Football In Week 7
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey's fantasy value has plummeted this season, and even more so when you compare it to previous seasons he had. The former No. 1 kicker in fantasy football sits outside the top-20 scorers at his position this season thanks to a Dallas offense that's regressed substantially since last year. He also has missed a whopping 25 percent of his field goal attempts and whiffed on one of his 15 extra point tries. His 75 percent field goal accuracy ranks near the bottom of the league, and his 12 total attempts is a middling number even when not accounting for some kickers missing a game due to bye weeks. We may see him have more luck against the Philadelphia Eagles in…

items.h: Mostly uninvolved in loss
items.s: Aubrey did not attempt any field goals but converted his only extra-point try during Sunday's 23-13 loss at Green Bay. In a game where the Cowboys fell into a hole early and turned the ball over three times in opposing territory, Aubrey was mostly a spectator, failing to make at least one field goal in a game for the first time since Week 1 against the Giants. Dallas' offense will have better days than it did Sunday, and one of those could come in Week 7 against a Philadelphia defense that has looked poor at times this season.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey held to one XP in Week 6 loss
items.s: Brandon Aubrey did not attempt a field goal while hitting his lone extra point in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6. Aubrey was held without a field-goal attempt for the second time this season as Dallas really struggled to move the ball on offense against Green Bay, especially in the first half. Aubrey has now hit nine of his 12 field goals and added 14 extra points this season. He will look to bounce back against the Eagles in Week 7.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Solid Starting Option for Fantasy Football in Week 6
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey is just a shadow of his former self for fantasy football this season. In Week 5, he scored just 5.0 fantasy points by kicking just one field goal and one extra point, though he made both of his attempt. Dallas' offense was putrid without WR CeeDee Lamb (quad) on the field. He's back, but the Packers have one of the NFL's toughest defenses against the pass. Aubrey saw so few opportunities in Week 5 that it was tough for him to succeed, though. In Week 6, with Lamb back and healthy, the Cowboys should have a much easier time moving the ball down the field and getting into kicking range. Cowboys running back Javonte Williams does a good job punching the…

items.h: Brandon Aubrey kick for four points in loss
items.s: Brandon Aubrey hit his only PAT and field goal attempts in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday. Aubrey was hindered by a Dallas offense that sputtered badly after their first drive, failing to do much more in the first half before a field goal. After that, the team was in catch-up mode, and Aubrey didn't see the field again. Better days will come for the star kicker.

items.h: Makes lone FG try Thursday
items.s: Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point try in a Week 5 loss to Tampa Bay on Thursday. Aubrey didn't get many opportunities to kick, but he did nail a 41-yard FG just before halftime. The All-Pro kicker is now 9-for-12 on field-goal tries this season, with all of his misses (including two that were blocked) coming from at least 59 yards out. Aubrey is still one of the league's elite kickers, and he figures to continue getting opportunities from very deep considering the strength of his leg.

items.h: Brandon Aubrey A Good Volume Start Despite Accuracy Issues
items.s: Dallas Cowboys kicker Brandon Aubrey missed two of his four field goal attempts in a Week 4 win over the Houston Texans. Though he was a ridiculously accurate kicker in his first season in the NFL, he's been markedly less on-point since then. He hovered around 85 percent accuracy in his second and third season as the Cowboys kicker and now sits at just under 73 percent. The Cowboys have a high-powered offense that's gotten them into scoring range with regularity this season, but Aubrey's fall-off is concerning. He managed 10 fantasy points last game and is the 14th ranked kicker by fantasy scoring in the NFL, though. And a Week 5 matchup with a hapless Tampa Bay Buccaneers team could be…

items.h: Brandon Aubrey misses two field goals Sunday
items.s: Brandon Aubrey made 2-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday. Aubrey hit a 39 and 50-yard field goal early. He later had a 62-yarder blocked and missed a 65-yard field goal.

items.h: Aubrey went 2-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made all four PATs in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.
items.s: Both of Aubrey's misses were from long distance, as he had a 62-yard attempt blocked and a 65-yard try go wide left, both of which came in the second quarter. He did convert 39- and 50-yard tries. On the season, Aubrey is now 7-for-10 on field-goal tries and 12-for-13 on extra-point attempts. He'll remain a top fantasy kicker for Thursday's game against the Bucs.

items.h: Aubrey went three of four on field-goal tries and 2-for-2 on extra-point attempts in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Ravens.
items.s: The kicker had a 59-yard attempt blocked in the third quarter. Aubrey has now missed one field goal and one extra point this season, though he is getting plenty of opportunities in Dallas' high-scoring offense, with nine extra-point attempts and seven field-goal tries through three games.

items.h: Aubrey went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made all four PATs in Sunday's 37-20 win over the Commanders.
items.s: It was a needed rebound game for Aubrey after he made just two of three extra-point tries in the Cowboys' Week 1 loss to the Giants. Drafted as the top fantasy kicker over the summer, Aubrey put up a big line against Washington, with his field goals coming from 25, 44 and 60 yards. He'll get a Week 3 home date with the Ravens next Sunday.

items.h: Aubrey made just two of three extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the Giants.
items.s: The big-legged kicker didn't attempt a field goal against New York. His missed PAT came after a Javonte Williams touchdown in which he also picked up a taunting penalty to push Aubrey's extra-point try back to a 48-yard attempt. Widely drafted as the top kicker in fantasy this summer, Aubrey's Week 1 was less than ideal. He finished as fantasy's No. 4 overall kicker in points per game last season.

items.h: Aubrey made three of four field-goal attempts and converted his lone PAT try in Friday's 27-24 preseason loss to the Saints.
items.s: Aubrey missed a 57-yard field-goal attempt wide right after converting from 49 yards and 51 yards, but he made the proper adjustment on his next long attempt and was successful on a 58-yard try in the final minute of the first half. After making at least 36 field goals in each of his three regular seasons with the Cowboys -- with a long of 60-plus yards in each campaign -- Aubrey is widely considered the NFL's best kicker heading into the 2026 regular season.

items.h: Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt from 29 yards and knocked home both extra-point tries in the Cowboys' 17-7 preseason win over the Seahawks on Saturday.
items.s: Aubrey became the NFL's highest-paid kicker this offseason by inking a $28 million extension, and he put together a signature perfect night in his first taste of game action since signing the deal. Aubrey's long-distance prowess is legendary, and he's seen a combined 34 field-goal attempts from 50-plus yards over the last two regular seasons, so he should remain the top fantasy option at his position again in 2026.

items.h: Aubrey agreed to terms Monday on a four-year, $28 million contract extension with the Cowboys that includes $20 million guaranteed, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
items.s: Aubrey's new deal with Dallas is record-setting, and as Adam Schefter of ESPN reports makes him the first kicker in NFL history to earn $7 million annually on average. Across 17 regular-season appearances in 2025, Aubrey converted 36 of his 42 field-goal attempts and was especially clutch from 50-plus yards, going 11-for-17. The Cowboys initially assigned Aubrey a second-round tender as a placeholder to work out a long-term deal.

items.h: The Cowboys placed a second-round tender valued at $5.76 million on Aubrey on Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
items.s: The tender gives the Cowboys the opportunity to match an offer sheet that another team gives to Aubrey, otherwise Dallas would net a second-round pick. He has been one of the best kickers in the NFL for the past couple of seasons, and Todd Archer of ESPN reported in February that Aubrey is seeking a contract that exceeds the league-high $6.4 million average that Harrison Butker receives. Aubrey went 36-for-42 on field-goal attempts across 17 regular-season games in 2025, including 11-for-17 from 50-plus yards.

items.h: The Cowboys have reportedly offered Aubrey a deal for more than Harrison Butker's league-high $6.4 million average per season, Todd Archer of ESPN reports.
items.s: Per the report, the Cowboys and Aubrey's agent Todd France are in agreement that the 30-year-old should be the highest-paid kicker in the NFL, but the team's reported offer falls short of the $10 million per season that France is said to be seeking. Aubrey is on track to become a restricted free agent next month, with Archer relaying that Cowboys are likely to place the second-round tender (at a cost of close to $5.8 million) on the Notre Dame product, who made 36 of his 42 field-goal attempts during the 2025 regular season en route to racking up a fantasy-friendly 155 points (third among…

items.h: Aubrey made 36 of his 42 field-goal tries and converted 47 of his 48 extra-point attempts in 17 games with Dallas in 2025.
items.s: After finishing first in fantasy points among NFL kickers in 2023 and second in 2024, Aubrey finished third in 2025 behind only Jason Myers and Ka'imi Fairbairn. He remained all but automatic for the purposes of PATs, but he was a bit less accurate from distance compared to his 2022 and 2023 numbers, especially down the stretch, when he hit just two of his six attempts of 50-plus yards during the final four games of the season. Fantasy investors will be watching closely to see if the Cowboys extend their contract with Aubrey for 2026 and possibly beyond this offseason, as he has been helped…

items.h: Puka Nacua leads list of players on most 2025 fantasy football championship rosters
items.s: The final "MNF" of the season featured two of the top three players rostered by 2025 fantasy football champions.

items.h: Aubrey made three of four field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries in Thursday's 30-23 win over Washington.
items.s: Aubrey's first field goal was a 42-yarder just before halftime. He then made a 52-yarder and a 51-yarder in the second half, though he also missed a 58-yard attempt early in the fourth quarter. Despite that miss, the big-legged kicker continued to show his almost limitless range -- he's now 11-for-16 on FG tries from 50-plus yards this season, including 3-for-4 from 60-plus yards.

items.h: Aubrey made his lone field-goal attempt and both extra-point tries in Sunday's 34-17 loss to the Chargers.
items.s: After missing a pair of field goals in last Sunday night's loss to the Vikings, Aubrey bounced back to make all three of his kicks against the Chargers. On the season, Aubrey has made 32 of 36 field-goal attempts and 42 of 43 PATs across 15 contests.

items.h: Aubrey missed two of his six field-goals attempts and converted both his extra-point tries in Sunday's 34-26 loss to the Vikings. He also added six yards on his only carry.
items.s: The Cowboys engaged in a bit of trickery on their opening possession, as Aubrey ran for a first down on a fake field goal from the Minnesota 29-yard line, but the trick ultimately may have been on Dallas. The star kicker seemed a little off the rest of the night, as he missed multiple field-goal tries (from 51 and 59 yards) at AT&T Stadium for the first time in his career. Aubrey still connected on tries from 37, 26, 41 and 41 yards, marking his third straight game with at least three successful field goals. For the season, Aubrey ranks second in the NFL with 133 points, trailing only…

items.h: Aubrey converted all five of his field-goal tries and his lone PAT in Thursday's Week 14 loss to the Lions.
items.s: Aubrey kept the Cowboys close for most of the game with his big leg. Among his field-goal makes were a 57-yarder in the first quarter, a 55-yarder in the second and a 63-yarder in the third. He now has six career field goals of 60-plus yards, the most in NFL history. Aubrey is 27-for-29 on FG tries and 28-of-29 on PATs this season.

items.h: Aubrey made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his point-after tries during the Cowboys' 31-28 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
items.s: Aubrey connected on a 49-yard field goal early in the second quarter, but his big leg wasn't challenged during Thursday's win after adding two more field goals from 36 and 26 yards. It was his sixth game with two or more made field goals but his first since Week 7 against the Commanders. Aubrey's fantasy value will remain elevated for as long as the Cowboys' offense keeps humming, and the third-year kicker is now 22-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 37-for-38 on extra-point tries through 12 regular-season games.

items.h: Aubrey went 1-for-2 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs in Sunday's 24-21 win over the Eagles.
items.s: Aubrey pushed a 51-yard field-goal attempt wide left in the third quarter, missing a field-goal for just the second time this season. The kicker got his redemption as time expired in regulation, converting a 42-yard game-winning field goal. Aubrey has now gone 19-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 6-for-8 from 50-plus yards, while making 35 of 36 PATs over 11 games this year.

items.h: Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt and all four extra-point tries Monday in a 33-16 win over Las Vegas.
items.s: Dallas' offense was firing on all cylinders Monday, so Aubrey was called upon for just one field-goal try. He made the 50-yarder with ease early in the first quarter, then went on to make each of his four extra-point tries. Aubrey's volume has been relatively low this season -- he's tried a modest 19 field goals through 10 games -- but he's made all but one of his attempts. His lone miss was a 68-yard try in Week 10.

items.h: Aubrey went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his both of his point-after tries during the Cowboys' 27-17 loss to the Cardinals on Monday.
items.s: Aubrey had an opportunity to match Cam Little's NFL record of a 68-yard field goal at the end of the first half, but the former's attempt did not have the accuracy, as the kick sailed wide left. Aubrey connected on a 26-yard chip shot in the third quarter, but that was the third-year kicker's only field goal as the Cowboys failed to convert on fourth-down attempts in the first and fourth quarters while in opposing territory. Aubrey enters the Week 10 bye having gone 17-for-18 on field-goal attempts and 28-for-29 on extra-point tries through nine regular-season games.

items.h: Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt and went 3-for-3 on extra-point tries in Sunday's 44-24 loss to the Broncos.
items.s: Aubrey connected on a 24-yard field goal to cap off the Cowboys' first possession of the game, which would prove to be his only field-goal try in the contest. The kicker has now gone 16-for-16 on field-goal attempts, including 5-for-5 from more than 50 yards, while making 26 of 27 PATs over eight contests this year.

items.h: Aubrey went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made all five of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 44-22 win over the Commanders.
items.s: Aubrey continued his terrific start to the season, making field goals from 47, 61 and 29 yards in the victory. The 61-yarder was particularly significant, as the kicker now has five career kicks of 60-plus yards, the most in NFL history. Aubrey has been nearly perfect this year, making all 15 of his field-goal attempts, including five makes from 50-plus yards, while going 23-for-24 on PATs over seven games.

items.h: Aubrey went 2-for-2 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs in Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Panthers.
items.s: Aubrey made a chip-shot 23-yard field goal in the first quarter before later adding a 28-yard make in the fourth. The kicker was able remain perfect on field goals, going 12-for-12 so far this year, including 4-for-4 from 50-plus yards, while making 18 of 19 PATs over six games this season.

items.h: Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt and went 4-for-5 on extra-point tries in Sunday's 37-22 win over the Jets.
items.s: The missed PAT came late in the first half with Dallas already leading by three scores. It was Aubrey's first miss on an extra-point attempt this season, and he remains perfect (10-for-10) on field goals this year. The kicker known for drilling long field goals is also the beneficiary of a high-scoring Dallas offense right now.

items.h: Aubrey converted his only field-goal attempt and all five of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 40-40 overtime tie with the Packers.
items.s: The third-year kicker remains perfect on the season, drilling nine straight FGs and 11 straight PATs to begin 2025. Aubrey's 38 total points puts him third in the NFL through four weeks behind the Colts' Spencer Shrader (51) and the Seahawks' Jason Myers (39), and his four made field goals of 50 yards or longer is tied for most in the league with the Bucs' Chase McLaughlin and the Titans' Joey Slye.

items.h: Aubrey made his only field-goal attempt and went 5-for-5 on extra-point tries in Sunday's 40-40 overtime tie against the Packers.
items.s: Aubrey was limited to just a chip-shot 22-yard field goal in the contest, which proved to be the final points of the game for the Cowboys in overtime. The kicker has now gone 9-for-9 on field-goal tries, including 4-for-4 on attempts of 50-plus yards, while making all 11 of his PATs over four games this year.

items.h: Aubrey converted both his field-goal attempts but didn't get an extra-point try in Sunday's loss to the Bears.
items.s: The star kicker drilled FGs of 53 and 33 yards in the first half, but his scoring opportunities dried up as the game got away from the Cowboys. Aubrey has yet to miss a kick in 2025, banging home six PATs and eight FGs through three games, but his chances could be limited again in Week 4 as Dallas takes on a Green Bay team allowing a league-low 14.7 points per game, and with the Cowboys potentially not having the services of CeeDee Lamb (ankle).

items.h: Aubrey connected on both of his field-goal attempts in the Cowboys' 31-14 loss to the Bears on Sunday.
items.s: The kicker also connected on a 53-yarder, his fourth from 50 or more in 2025. Altogether, Aubrey is now eight for eight on field-goal tries and six of six on extra-point attempts to begin the season.

items.h: Aubrey went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and also made all four of his extra-point tries in Sunday's 40-37 overtime win against the Giants.
items.s: Aubrey made a 51-yard field goal in the second quarter before adding a 44-yard make to open the fourth quarter, a 64-yard game-tying kick at the end of regulation and a game-winning 46-yarder as time expired in overtime. The kicker has been historically good since joining the Cowboys ahead of the 2023 campaign, and he's now off to an impressive start to the 2025 season. Through two games, Aubrey has made all seven of his field-goal tries, including five makes from 50-plus yards.

items.h: Aubrey made both of his field-goal attempts and a pair of PATs in Thursday's 24-20 loss to the Eagles.
items.s: The Cowboys started hot on offense, scoring touchdowns on their first two drives before setting Aubrey up for field goals of 41 and 53 yards. After making the latter kick to close out the first half, Aubrey didn't get another chance to add to his total as Philadelphia's defense stepped up in the second half. Aubrey's mix of power and accuracy is elite, so he should remain one of the top kickers in fantasy as long as Dallas' offense moves the ball at a decent clip.

items.h: Aubrey connected on his only field goal attempt and all four of his extra points in Friday's 31-13 preseason win over the Falcons.
items.s: Aubrey showed he was ready for the regular season with another jaw-dropping kick, as he drilled a 64-yard FG right at the end of the first half. Heading into his third NFL season, the Notre Dame product remains the league's preeminent kicker from long distance after converting 14 of 17 attempts from 50 yards or longer in 2024. If Dak Prescott can stay healthy and lead the Cowboys' offense to a better overall performance this year, it might turn some of those desperation FGs into PATs, but Aubrey figures to be extremely productive regardless -- after leading the league with 157 points as a…

items.h: Aubrey (shoulder) kicked field goals during Thursday's practice, Calvin Watkins of The Dallas Morning News reports.
items.s: Aubrey underwent surgery on his shoulder during the offseason, but the third-year kicker has recovered from the procedure and will be a full participant in training camp. Aubrey is coming off a 2024 campaign in which he went 40-for-47 on field-goal attempts (including 14-for-17 from 50-plus yards) and made all 30 of his extra-point tries across 17 regular-season games.

items.h: Aubrey underwent shoulder surgery this offseason, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
items.s: Aubrey is expected to be ready to go for the Cowboys' offseason program after undergoing a minor procedure on his shoulder. The kicker is coming off a 2024 campaign in which he made 40 of 47 field-goal attempts, including an impressive 14-for-17 from 50-plus yards.
